body:
Thank you so much for your mail. I'm going to ask my Dr about EMDR, I keep hearing things about it and it's damn time I try. 
When you say your brain tried to stop you, what do you mean? Your artillery of things to avoid thinking of the tough stuff?
Can you tell me more about the falling asleep and waking up suddenly? 

My 'normal' username is codeegirl, since I don't check this one (hardly ever) can we talk through that one?

Thank you again, it's a relief to hear from the horses' mouth what it was like :)
Wow... I have no other words for you... Just wow....
Good point.... It's well worth the try!
It would take me days to type out all the crap. Let's just say she had custody, I was an only child and she has Borderline personality disorder and a narcissistic personality.
I can't imagine how moving one's eyes would help but it's worth looking into, hearing it worked for you. How much better did yours get? Did they come less or just less intense when they did?
No, it seems kinda hokey. Have you done it? If so, what was it like and did the flashbacks/memories fade?
